recipe.origin: Only item.plan.origin: memory = Remembered from an approved layout of the same columns; teacher = Proposed by the model; officer = Written by an officer; null = not supplied by the record. Do not infer from authoredBy.
recipe.missingLines: Absent name/height say not stated. Tabular mapping has no GeoJSON identifier line and null destination: not supplied by the record. Unknown future members are listed by name.

lifecycle.noRecipe: probed / needs_answer / plan null, stored reason No approved layout matches this file. An officer chooses the identifier field.
lifecycle.proposed: worker transition: planned / undecided, plan proposed, origin retained
lifecycle.approved: approve queues worker; planned / undecided then reading / undecided
lifecycle.executed: worker executes itself; read / on_map, plan executed with packageId; targets created and package areaId published

events.recipe.changed: author, approve, execute; invalidate manifest, all displayed recipe histories, targets
events.intake.item: probe and worker ledger transitions; same invalidations
events.resync: set head cursor, refetch once, reconnect automatically

lifecycle.fallback: Only unsettled tray items: quiet reads no faster than 5 seconds. Errors close and reconnect from head on next 5-second tick. Banner after two consecutive failed reconnects, clear on success. Run panel independently keeps its own stream and fallback.
lifecycle.suspectedBlocker: service.ts author lines 202-228 saves receipt and emits recipe.changed but never calls queueIntakeDraftTx. Initial worker can already have completed with plan null. Manifest projects only stored plan_ref (intake-ledger.ts:19-34); event payload cannot replace it. Author after no-layout completion therefore cannot reach item.plan without backend change. Verify exact request on disposable runtime; stop affected walk if confirmed.
